candidates: A window exists but is unspecified in this schedule
ambiguities.reason: The contract requires the seller payout reversal to precede any refund but specifies no time window within which the reversal must occur.
ambiguities.source_quote: Where a refund is issued the Seller payout shall first be reversed.

commission.source_quote: The Seller shall receive eighty percent (80%) of the Net Order Value; the balance is the Platform's commission.

delivery_fee.source_quote: A delivery fee of Rs. 45.00 per confirmed delivery is payable to the assigned delivery partner.

hold.source_quote: The Seller's share shall become payable upon confirmation of delivery with no further hold.

promotion_funding.source_quote: Discounts shall be funded 100% by the Seller.

provenance.notes: SYNTHETIC contract corpus — not a real merchant agreement.

refund.source_quote: Where a refund is issued the Seller payout shall first be reversed. Commission is refundable.

tax.source_quote: The Platform shall withhold tax at source at one percent (1%) of the commission amount.
